evals.prompt: 帮我创建一个把客服工单分类并生成回复草稿的 skill，我只有这个想法。
evals.expected_output: A focused clarification followed by a complete skill package once blocking details are known.
assertions: Asks no more than three high-value questions at a time
Defines triggers, non-triggers, outputs, and quality criteria
Adds only resources that reduce real complexity

evals.prompt: 这里有一份完整任务卡，请直接生成 skill，不需要再确认。
evals.expected_output: A complete implementation without redundant clarification.
assertions: Creates a concise SKILL.md with progressive disclosure

evals.prompt: 审核并优化这个已有 skill，使它更容易触发且更可靠。
evals.expected_output: An evidence-based audit and implemented improvements.
assertions: Improves description precision with positive and negative boundaries
Adds regression tests or evals proportional to risk
Does not add unrelated documentation clutter
